name: command
title: Command menu
description: A Cmd+K command menu that filters without a cut: rows that stop matching leave in place, the rest slide into the gaps and one highlight moves between rows.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Command menu from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Command } from "@/components/ui/motion-command".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-command.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createCommand on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/command/command.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#command
